note: Adaptive left signal panel. All PNGs are 2x: draw at half the pixel size. Geometry marked Css is in CSS px; Px is PNG px. Night = body[data-lighting="night"].

panel.position: left:18px; top:66px (same spot as today's #chart-panel); PiP video is right:18px top:66px 200x150, so they never overlap on a >=520px wide window

frame.note: painted at exactly 282x136 so it is pixel-perfect at the default size; it stretches cleanly from ~200 to ~420 px wide (edges are paper + stitch)

glow.use: show (opacity 1) while the camera detects the state's action; gentle 2.4s breathing pulse 0.75<->1; idle glow stays at 0.55, no pulse

live.note: right-aligned; keep the existing G kbd chip at right:14px

chartBackground.note: sits directly under the canvas (same box). Painted wash + pencil grid; code draws only lines/fills on a cleared, transparent canvas.
chartBackground.plotNote: smile + talk + idle: grid painted for this rect (x0=20,y0=6,plotW=222,plotH=60, exactly smile-chart.js). Smile grid: solid line at 0, dashed at 0.5 and 1, dashed verticals every 2 s of a 10 s window. Talk: solid midline at y0+plotH/2, dashed guides at 18% / 82%.
chartBackground.breatheNote: wave in breathePlot (dashed midline painted); bottom row: existing breath-rate pill (ui/breath/pill-warming|settling|stable.png, 9-slice 28 32, 32px tall) at pillX/pillY, 92px wide, existing 24px icon at +10px, ONE short word (Warming / Settling / Steady), rate itself goes in the header live value; then up to 6 existing dots (ui/breath/dot-on/off.png drawn at 16px, gap 5) from dotsX. The pills/dots have no night variant (same as the breath guide today).

gauge.direction: mirrored-view: 0deg = upright; positive (clockwise) = needle leans to SCREEN RIGHT = the way the player sees their head move in the mirrored preview. Use the same sign as the post-#15 tilt hint arrows, NOT raw camera roll (raw roll is un-mirrored and needs a sign flip).
gauge.draw: canvas: ctx.drawImage(arc, 39, 0, 172, 82.5); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(125, 82); ctx.rotate(deg * Math.PI / 180); ctx.drawImage(needle, -7, -52.8, 14, 59); ctx.restore();  (or the DOM version in signal-panel.css: .signal-gauge-arc / .signal-gauge-needle with --tilt)
gauge.holdZone: optional: tint the arc ends with the state fill while the hold timer runs

smile.label: Watering
smile.chart: line = HAPPY score; fill under the line while watering (score above the 0.50 on-threshold); on-threshold dashed in accent, off-threshold dashed in grid; no-face gaps rgba(150,140,130,0.18)

talk.label: Fertilizing
talk.chart: soft voice wave: mirrored amplitude envelope around the painted midline, filled with fill, edge stroked with line at 1.6px, round joins; smooth amplitude with ~120ms EMA so it reads as a gentle wave

stretch.label: Staking
stretch.chart: no line chart: draw gauge-arc + gauge-needle; optional hold progress as a thin line arc (line colour, 3px, round caps) at tickRadius-6

breathe.label: Harvesting
breathe.chart: breath wave in breathePlot with fill under it + existing pill and dots row

idle.label: Waiting for you
idle.chart: nothing drawn (painted resting leaf + dashed calm line are in the background); fade the canvas to empty

transition.canvas: fade canvas to 0 over 150ms, switch draw mode, fade back over 150ms
transition.hysteresis: suggest holding a detected state >=400ms before switching and >=1.2s of nothing before going idle, so the panel never flickers
